events.title: GDGoC LDCE Orientation — 2025
events.description: The official orientation of GDGoC LDCE marked the beginning of our community journey. The session introduced students to the GDGoC mission, yearly roadmap, Google Developer ecosystem, and the opportunities available for the upcoming academic cycle.

highlights.text: Introduction to GDG ecosystem & student benefits

events.title: Google Cloud Study Jam 2025
events.description: The Google Cloud Study Jam 2025 at GDGoC LDCE was a month-long cloud upskilling journey where students learned Google Cloud fundamentals through labs, quests, and hands-on activities. The program achieved Tier 1 status with exceptional participation and completion rates.

syllabus: The Basics of Google Cloud Compute
Get Started with Google Workspace Tools
Develop with Apps Script and AppSheet
Build a Website on Google Cloud
Set Up a Google Cloud Network
Store, Process, and Manage Data on GCP
Analyze Speech & Language with Google APIs
Develop GenAI Apps with Gemini & Streamlit
